meta.name: DARK MACHINE THE ANIMATION
meta.description: “Find Senki,” those were the final words of Kairi’s grandfather and now his mission. DARK MACHINE, a new and captivating eSport game, transformed Japan’s economy. The most powerful player controls it with the title Senki. Now, on the seventh Senki, Kairi plays to finally meet them and ultimately take claim. Will he be able to hold his own, though?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Kairi leaves his island to carry out his grandfather's dying wish, but gets caught up with Rudra and her team.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Rudra sets Carbuncle up against tougher opponent, this time on Kairi's dime.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Kairi learns more about his teammates when he and Shinn attempt to find the runaway Bran.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The Senki Cup kicks off between the top teams, with Carbuncle seeking a way in.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Kairi has a mysterious encounter before playing his next round opponent, Stellatus.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Carbuncle's next opponent is a group of high schoolers, one with an ability close to future sight.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Kairi revisits old opponents in a quest to realize why he's playing Dark Machine.
